author: agent:claude-code
message: The stop guard flagged license.manifest on the Rust template's Cargo.toml; a template's manifest is the future project's, not this repo's. (proposal 01a199b2-2a43-73c0-bbc3-ccb58f0e31c3, proposed by agent:claude-code, accepted by user)

text: Template manifests name no license: the project made from one takes its own
why: dev-utils/nix-templates/* are copied verbatim into new projects by `nix flake init`, so a license in a template's manifest (Cargo.toml, pyproject.toml, package.json) would hand vg-dotfiles' license choice to every project started from it. Each new project gets its license from its own baseline (`tend baseline render`, its [license] in .tend/extends.toml), and license.manifest is checked there. Here it is waived for the templates only.
